title: Owner: the macOS window opens at 1200x800
context: During the owner's own Mac test on 2026-10-03, the app opened at its minimum size (about 873x632), and the onboarding Mood bloom overlapped the heading and subtitle. This confirmed the lab finding.
options: Open the window at a larger default size
Scale the onboarding scene to the window height
outcome: The owner asked for a larger opening size, in their words: "Set to 1200x800 to give it a good clearance". It is implemented in fix/device-pass-followups (c819e86f). The window frame opens at 1200x800, fitted to the screen's visible area, never below the minimum content size, and centred. The minimum size is unchanged.
